messages:
jordan_support: Escalation from Acme — streaming responses get truncated when their gRPC gateway translates h2->h1. Customer sees partial SSE payloads and then a final short chunk, reconnects on auth rotate. They say it started after they added an edge auth proxy.
emma_sre: ack, can you paste the minimal repro they gave?
jordan_support: Yep. Repro they provided:
```
curl -N -H \"Authorization: Bearer <token>\" --http2 https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream?model=test
```
On their side the gateway is gRPC->HTTP1.1 (envoy) and the client is HTTP/2. They also show this wrapper config snippet that forces keepalive and flush intervals.
```yaml
- name: envoy.filters.http.grpc_web
  typed_config: {}
- name: envoy.filters.http.router
  typed_config: {}
```
liam_eng: Do we have request logs showing the connection mode or any RST_STREAM?
emma_sre: I pulled our access logs for that customer around the times they called out: we see proper h2 conns but then lots of 200s with truncated body length headers and a burst of 502/UPSTREAM_RST_STREAM from the gateway. Example from ingress logs:
```
[ingress] ts=2765432202 conn=h2 id=abcd status=200 bytes=1234 truncated=true
[upstream] ts=2765432205 error=UPSTREAM_RST_STREAM code=8
```
jordan_support: They also reported duplicate billing for partially delivered chunks when the client reconnects — charges for tokens that weren't visible to the user.
devin_infra: Important: billing should dedupe based on token stream id/session. I'll flag infra. For root cause though we need to confirm if chunk coalescing or early flush is happening at the gRPC gateway.
liam_eng: Quick hypothesis: intermediary is coalescing/truncating HTTP/1.1 chunk boundaries when converting from HTTP/2 DATA frames, causing clients that expect event-by-event framing to miss separators. Also if auth rotation forces re-authorization mid-stream the gateway might close stream with RST then retry a short final chunk.
emma_sre: I reproduced locally by running a simple h2 client -> envoy (grpc-web disable) -> drops midstream. With verbose http2 logs I see:
```
[client] >>> FIN_STREAM
[envoy] translates: sends CRLF-terminated chunk but coalesces into next chunk without proper flush
[client] sees partial event, then reconnect
```
jordan_support: Customer says they see this pattern with browsers that have reconnect logic as well.
liam_eng: Possible mitigation: add SSE server-side explicit "\n" separators and flush after each event (socket-level TCP_CORK/TCP_NODELAY hints). Can we add a small guard in runtime to force flush on every "event" boundary for models served to that customer?
devin_infra: We can toggle the flushing option per-customer behind a config flag. But we should be careful on perf/cost since more flushes -> less batching -> higher token cost.
emma_sre: For immediate customer workaround: 1) ask them to disable the gateway HTTP/1.1 chunk coalescing option or enable grpc_web_translator preserve_fragmentation; 2) rotate to an h2-only path (bypass envoy) if possible; 3) we can flip our per-customer flush flag for them while we investigate.
liam_eng: On the auth rotate: if the auth proxy issues 401->reauth flow during a long stream, some gateways close stream instead of propagating 401 mid-stream. That causes a reconnect and puts partial tokens into billing. We need to detect midstream auth closures and treat them as non-billable if no final model tokens returned.
devin_infra: I'll open an infra ticket to add a stream-session id marker to billing events so we can dedupe. For the engineering fix I'll need logs with request IDs from both sides. Jordan can you ask Acme to send last 4 chars of request-id from their gateway for a repro time?
jordan_support: Done, asked and they provided request-id 6f3b9c at 2765432199.
emma_sre: I correlated it: our traces show:
```
trace=6f3b9c span=ingress->gateway timestamp=2765432199 upstream=envoy-12 error=RST_STREAM
```
liam_eng: Next steps I'm going to: 1) reproduce with envoy config that translates grpc_web->h1 with keepalive; 2) patch runtime to optionally flush on SSE event; 3) add a small heuristics in gateway router to avoid coalescing CRLF if content-type text/event-stream.
devin_infra: Infra task: add stream-session id to billing export + create backfill to refund obvious dup charges for Acme.
jordan_support: I'll send Acme the workaround steps and an ETA: repro + possible runtime flag change in 48h, billing refund in 72h. 
liam_eng: FYI will post a short PR with repro harness and logs. If anyone wants to pair on envoy repro, ping me.
emma_sre: adding :thumbsup: — will follow up after we try the runtime toggle on staging.
sre_bot: incident-note created: INC-2026-276543 — \"sse streaming truncation via grpc-gateway\" assigned to liam_eng, devin_infra.
jordan_support: thanks team, closing loop with customer now.
